Container.Name: Tapeory
Container.Overview: Tapeory is a self-hosted web app for designing, storing, and printing Brother P-touch labels from your browser. This template needs a separate MySQL/MariaDB container (e.g. Unraid's official "mariadb" Community Applications template) reachable from this container.
Container.Description: Tapeory is a self-hosted web app for designing, storing, and printing Brother P-touch labels from your browser (network, print-server, hostname, or USB-connected printers). One container serves both the web UI and the API; it needs a MySQL/MariaDB database (its connection details are entered in the web UI on first start) and a host folder for template/upload storage. See the project README for install, upgrade, backup, and restore instructions.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Tapeory web UI and API are served on.

Config.Name: Storage Path
Config.Description: Host folder for templates, uploads, and rendered print output. Back this up regularly.

Config.Name: Database Connection String
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to enter the database connection in the web UI on first start (it's saved to the storage path). If set, e.g. server=192.168.1.10;port=3306;database=tapeory;user=tapeory;password=CHANGE_ME; it overrides that and the setup screen is skipped.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the storage path; the app runs as this user. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the storage path. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Auto Migrate Database
Config.Description: Automatically apply pending database migrations on container start.
